subject: Infra paths qualification and pricing synthesis
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Infra paths qualification and pricing synthesis

Sam — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and action items from our side so we stay aligned: 

Summary of requirements (what you confirmed on the call):
- Primary workload: clinical notes summarization + patient routing (batch + low-latency inference).
- Monthly volume: ~18M generated tokens/month initially; expected to scale to ~60M within 6–9 months.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 350ms for short queries; occasional longer batch jobs acceptable.
- Data constraints: PHI in payloads; prefer VPC or dedicated isolation with customer-managed keys.

Deployment paths we discussed:
1) Hosted API: fastest to get started, per-token billing, no infra commitment, Redwood-managed keys. Good for pilot and quick integration.
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): predictable throughput and isolation, fixed monthly commit with capacity-based pricing — lower per-token unit cost at scale.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation, customer KMS/HSM, longer lead time for onboarding and SOW.

Preliminary economics (see attached spreadsheet for line-item math):
- Hosted per-token: ~0.0009 $/token effective for our recommended model at your mix (embeds + gen), estimated $16k/month at 18M tokens.
- Dedicated reserve (3x A100 equiv reserved): estimated fixed commit $28k/month with ~30–40% unit-cost improvement once you exceed ~35M tokens/month.
- Private VPC: bump to $36k/mo (initial infra + ops) but preferred for compliance; amortizes over 12+ months.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Sam: confirm whether Procurement wants a break-even analysis vs tokens-only at 12/24 month terms (they mentioned internal CAPEX preference).
- Alex/Marissa: we'll send a short sensitivity chart (tokens/day break-even, 12- and 24-month commit scenarios) + draft SOW.
- Ben: please attach a conservative latency SLO table we can include in the SOW.

Attachments: Orion_MAAP_TCO_calc.xlsx (workload assumptions + model-level unit economics).

Thanks — goal is a pilot PO or a 3-month reserved commit trial so you can validate throughput and cost math.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Park <sam.park@orionhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra paths qualification and pricing synthesis

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications before we take this to Procurement: 

1) The 18M tokens/month is our current steady state; the 60M is based on an aggressive growth scenario. Can you model a 12-month ramp (18M, 30M, 45M, 60M) and show when Dedicated becomes cheaper than Hosted?
2) For Private/VPC: we need to confirm whether onboard requires any on-prem hardware for the initial pilot. Procurement prefers cloud-hosted VPC if possible.
3) Can you provide a sample SOW template and proposed security addenda (we need KMS and SOC2 language).

Also cc'ing Procurement (procure@orionhealth.com) — they'll want the break-even table and an estimate for 12 vs 24 month Reserved Commit discounts.

Sam
Director, AI Platforms | Orion Health
sam.park@orionhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@orionhealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Infra paths qualification and pricing synthesis

Sam — looping in some concrete numbers and a recommended pilot structure. I ran the ramp you asked for and included a sensitivity section in the attached spreadsheet. Highlights below: 

Pilot & commercial recommendation:
- Pilot scope: 30-day technical pilot on Hosted with 18M tokens (no commit) + option to convert to a 3-month Dedicated trial with a 40% credit toward commit if you convert within 45 days. This gives you a fast start and a protected path to evaluate Dedicated without committing long term.

12-month ramp break-even (summary):
- Month 1 (18M tokens): Hosted cost estimate ~$16k/month.
- Month 3 (30M tokens): Hosted ~$27k/month vs Dedicated pro-rata ~$24k/month (Dedicated becomes competitive).
- Month 6+ (45–60M): Dedicated commit provides ~30–45% unit savings vs Hosted depending on model quantization and batching.

Reserved commit options (examples):
- 3× A100-equivalent pool, 12-month term: $330k/yr (~$27.5k/mo). Best for predictable throughput and lower latency jitter.
- 6× pool (higher headroom) with 24-month term: $600k/yr with deeper per-unit discounts and a migration assistance credit.

Security & Private/VPC note:
- Private VPC is cloud-hosted (no on-prem hardware required for your use-case) — it offers customer KMS and VPC peering. On-prem package is available but not needed unless you require air-gapped operations. We'll include SOC2 + KMS language in the security addendum.

Attachments included: Orion_MAAP_TCO_calc.xlsx (ramp scenarios + break-even charts), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (template). 

Next steps I propose:
1) Alex to share the 12/24-month break-even slides with Procurement (by EOD Thu).
2) Sam/Procurement to confirm preferred commercial path (Pilot → Dedicated trial vs straight-to-12mo commit).
3) Ben to provide SLO table and integration checklist by Friday.

If you want, I can draft a two-paragraph executive summary for Procurement summarizing cost delta and compliance posture.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Sam Park <sam.park@orionhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra paths qualification and pricing synthesis

Thanks — that looks good. Procurement confirms they want the 12-month break-even and a short exec summary for their CFO. Please include both the Hosted-to-Dedicated ramp chart and a line that calls out break-even month (looks like month 3 based on your numbers).

We are comfortable starting with the 30-day Hosted pilot and reserving the right to convert to a 3-month Dedicated trial if the throughput and latency look good. Procurement asked to see a draft SOW and the security addendum before issuing the PO — can you send both?

Sam
